title: Multi-field oscillons/I-balls in the Friedberg-Lee-Sirlin model
summary: We study oscillon/I-ball solutions in a real scalar version of the Friedberg-Lee-Sirlin (FLS) model. Using the multiple-scale analysis, we derive the conditions for oscillon solutions and explore multi-field oscillon configurations. In these configurations, the two fields form co-located oscillons that oscillate with frequencies set by their respective masses. These multi-field oscillons can be viewed as a bound state of two oscillons due to attractive interactions between the fields.
